user.title: Git Config Updater
user.description: Install changes to a git-managed Home Assistant configuration from the UI.

data_description.token: A fine-grained token with read-only Contents access to the repository.
data_description.path: The local git checkout Home Assistant runs from, usually /config.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the GitHub token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new fine-grained token for {repository} (read-only Contents).

error.invalid_repository: Use the owner/name form, e.g. your-user/ha-config.
error.repository_not_found: The repository doesn't exist or the token can't see it.
error.branch_not_found: That branch doesn't exist in the repository.
error.not_a_checkout: That path isn't a git checkout.
error.git_missing: The git command isn't available in this Home Assistant installation.

abort.already_configured: This repository, branch and path are already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check GitHub for new commits.
data_description.backup: Create a Home Assistant backup before each install.
data_description.packages_dir: Directory of package YAML files, relative to the checkout.
data_description.require_ci: Refuse to install a commit whose GitHub checks haven't passed (needs Checks or Commit statuses read access).
data_description.restart_globs: One glob per line; a changed file matching one forces a restart instead of a reload.
data_description.reload_globs: One glob per line, e.g. secrets.fake.yaml; a changed file matching one never asks for a restart.

restart_required.title: Restart needed to finish the config update

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
